evals.prompt: We just adopted this repo and switched the team to claude-opus-4.5. Onboard the project — fix up the readme, agents.md, build config, whatever's stale — then read the whole thing and tell me what's broken or no longer needed.
evals.expected_output: Runs project-detection, produces a model prompting brief via the model-card-review workflow (or fallback), delegates AGENTS.md to agent-file-upsert and README to readme-upsert, runs the doctor sweep, and emits a change report with letter+number IDs the user can select from
assertions: produces or consumes a model prompting brief before the audit
delegates AGENTS.md to agent-file-upsert rather than hand-writing it
delegates README.md to readme-upsert rather than hand-writing it
emits a report with lettered clusters and numbered changes (e.g. D1, B2)
only auto-fixes certain items; lists proposed/optional for review

evals.prompt: New project day — run the onboarding. We're on gemini-3-pro now.
evals.expected_output: Scopes the run (new project + new model), runs the model-card-review workflow for gemini-3-pro, delegates the fixup skills, sweeps the project, and renders findings via onboarding-report.py
assertions: runs model-card-review or the references/model-card-brief.md fallback
uses scripts/onboarding-report.py render for the report
presents changes with IDs and asks the user to select before applying proposed/optional changes

evals.prompt: apply D1 and all of B, skip S2
evals.expected_output: Parses the selection via onboarding-report.py select (apply D1 + all proposed B changes, skip S2), applies the approved changes, commits per git-repository-management conventions
assertions: uses onboarding-report.py select rather than re-interpreting the reply ad hoc
does not apply unmentioned proposed/optional changes
mentions git-repository-management conventions for the commit

evals.prompt: review this pull request for me
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger project-onboarding — routes to code-review-guidance instead
assertions: does not run the doctor sweep or fixup stages
